connection.name: 传输底座：TCP/IP socket 通信
connection.description: FOCAS 以太网版基于与 FANUC Ethernet Board / Fast Ethernet Board 的 socket（TCP/IP）通信；16i/18i/21i-B 与 30i/31i/32i-A 亦可用 CNC 内置的 Embedded Ethernet 功能。

spec_ref.quote: Ethernet version is realized by the socket communication (TCP/IP communication) with FANUC Ethernet Board, or FANUC Fast Ethernet Board. And in case of Series 16i/18i/21i-MODEL B and Series 30i/31i/32i-MODEL A, Ethernet version can communicate with CNC side by the "Embedded Ethernet function".

connection.name: Embedded Ethernet 与 CNC 共享 CPU 的相互影响
connection.description: Embedded Ethernet 通信在 CNC CPU 上处理：加工工况可拖慢通信，通信负载也可影响 CNC 画面/宏执行等进程（手册随后建议 DNC 操作等应用不要跑在 Embedded Ethernet 上）。

spec_ref.quote: The communication using the Embedded Ethernet is processed on the CNC CPU. This means that the running condition of CNC may affect the communication performance of the Embedded Ethernet, and conversely, the communication condition of the Embedded Ethernet may affect the process of CNC.

connection.name: 以太网建连：cnc_allclibhndl3
connection.description: 以太网版用 cnc_allclibhndl3 传入 CNC 的 IP 地址（或主机名）来获取库句柄并建立 TCP/IP 连接；连接前须在 CNC 侧正确设置 FOCAS1/FOCAS2 Ethernet (TCP) 的 IP 与端口号。

spec_ref.quote: At the library for Ethernet, to establish the communication with the Ethernet Board on CNC side, it is necessary to get the library handle number and create the TCP/IP connection by passing a CNC's IP address parameter to the cnc_allclibhndl3 function.

connection.name: 句柄须全程持有
connection.description: 库句柄是后续所有 CNC/PMC Data window 函数的第一参数，获取后必须持有到应用结束。

spec_ref.quote: Once the library handle number is acquired, it must be held until the application program terminates, because it is necessary to pass the number as an argument to each CNC/PMC Data window library function.

connection.name: 句柄线程归属
connection.description: 库句柄由获取它的线程独占：线程 A 把句柄交给线程 B，B 也无法使用（多线程各取各的句柄；同一线程可多次调用取多个句柄，如双路径系统给同一 CNC 的两条路径各配一个句柄）。

spec_ref.quote: The library handle is owned by the thread that got it. Even if the thread-A which has already got a library handle shows the library handle to another thread-B, the thread-B cannot use that library handle.

connection.name: 同 IP 同进程共用一条 TCP 连接
connection.description: 对同一 IP 的多个句柄，库按进程只建一条 TCP/IP 连接以节省 CNC 侧以太网板资源；该连接因通信错误断开时，共用它的所有句柄一起失效。

spec_ref.quote: If you create some handles for the same IP address, the library creates only one TCP/IP connection per process. This is for saving the resource of the Ethernet Board on the CNC side. So when the connection of one library handle is destroyed by the communication error and TCP/IP connection closes, the connection in other handle is destroyed, too.

connection.name: 句柄生命周期：必须 cnc_freelibhndl 释放
connection.description: 应用结束前必须用 cnc_freelibhndl 释放句柄；不释放则句柄管理内存累积，最终句柄耗尽无法再取。

quote: When an application program terminates, the library handles must be released by using the cnc_freelibhndl function.

If an application program terminates without releasing the library handle number, the memory area assigned for the management of the handle remains allocated and accumulates. If it is repeated, the library handle number will become unable to be acquired at last.

connection.name: HSSB 版：NC 断电后句柄失效（EW_HSSB/EW_HANDLE）
connection.description: HSSB 连接的 NC 断电后其句柄失效：失效句柄再执行返回 EW_HSSB；NC 重新上电后再用失效句柄则返回 EW_HANDLE，失效句柄必须 cnc_freelibhndl 释放后重取。（cnc_allclibhndl/2 在 NC 未上电时也回 EW_HSSB，刚上电初始化未完时回 EW_BUSY 需重试。）

spec_ref.quote: If the library function is executed with the invalid library handle, the completion status of EW_HSSB is returned.

connection.name: 以太网版：CNC 断电的 half-open 检测
connection.description: CNC 断电时 TCP 复位不会到达 PC 侧，库无法立即察觉（TCP 术语 half-open）；此时再执行库函数，将在 cnc_allclibhndl3 指定的 timeout 时刻发生超时错误，随后该 CNC 的所有句柄变为无效（以太网版失效句柄再执行返回 EW_SOCKET）。采集端应在超时后释放句柄并重连。

quote: When the power supply of CNC is turned off after the library handle is acquired, the connection is not disabled soon. If the power is turned off, the library cannot detect the disconnection of TCP/IP because TCP/IP reset is not noticed from the Ethernet Board on the CNC side. (This status is called 'half-open' as TCP/IP technical term.)

After executing the library in the half-open state, the timeout error is occurred at the time which is specified in cnc_allclibhndl3, and then all library handles of the CNC whose power supply has been turned off become invalid.
